deep_analysis.text: Cross-asset signals are pulling in different directions this session. Gold's firmer while VIX slides and equities grind higher, a combination that doesn't fit a clean risk-off or risk-on script, and DXY sitting flat reinforces that indecision. Headlines lean hawkish-Fed, with commentary pointing to lifted rate-hike bets pressuring European currencies while yen support builds on stronger Japanese inflation data. Copper and oil both firming hints at underlying demand resilience despite the mixed tape. The dollar bloc and risk-sensitive currencies remain in a tug-of-war
